.. _X_145:

X_145
=====

.. rubric:: ANTICOMPLEMENT OF NAGEL POINT

.. enunciation::

   Let :g:`O_{A} <O_A>` be the circle tangent to side :g:`BC <[ B C ]>` at its midpoint and to the circumcircle on the same side of :g:`BC <[ B C ]>` as A. Define :g:`O_{B} <O_B>`, :g:`O_{C} <O_C>` cyclically. Then :ref:`X_145 <X_145>` is the :term:`trilinear pole <trilinear-pole>` of the line of the exsimilicenters (the Monge line) of :g:`O_{A} <O_A>`, :g:`O_{B} <O_B>`, :g:`O_{C} <O_C>`. See the reference at :ref:`X_1001 <X_1001>`.

Notes
-----

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`A' <A'>` be the reflection of the midpoint of segment :g:`BC <[ B C ]>` in :ref:`X_1 <X_1>`, and define :g:`B' <B'>` and :g:`C' <C'>` cyclically. The lines :g:`AA' <[ A A' ]>`, :g:`BB' <[ B B' ]>`, :g:`CC' <[ C C' ]>` concur in :ref:`X_145 <X_145>`. Let :g:`A″ <A″>` be the reflection of the A in :ref:`X_1 <X_1>`, and define :g:`B″ <B″>` and :g:`C″ <C″>` cyclically. Let A'''B'''C''' be the intouch triangle. The lines A''A''', B''B''', C''C''' concur in :ref:`X_145 <X_145>`. (:person:`Randy Hutson <randy-hutson>`, 9/23/2011)

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`H_{a} <H_a>` be the hyperbola passing through :g:`A <A>`, with foci at :g:`B <B>` and C. This is called the A-Soddy hyperbola in (:person:`Paul Yiu <paul-yiu>`, Introduction to the Geometry of the Triangle, 2002; 12.4 The Soddy hyperbolas, p. 143). Let :g:`L_{a} <L_a>` be the polar of :ref:`X_2 <X_2>` with respect to :g:`H_{a} <H_a>`. Define :g:`L_{b} <L_b>` and :g:`L_{c} <L_c>` cyclically. The lines :g:`L_{a} <L_a>`, :g:`L_{b} <L_b>`, :g:`L_{c} <L_c>` concur in :ref:`X_145 <X_145>`. (Randy Hutson, September 5, 2015)

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` and :g:`A″B″C″ << A″ B″ C″ >>` be the intouch and :term:`extouch triangles <extouch-triangle>`. :ref:`X_145 <X_145>` is the radical center of the circumcircles of :g:`AA'A″ << A A' A″ >>`, :g:`BB'B″ << B B' B″ >>`, :g:`CC'C″ << C C' C″ >>`. (Randy Hutson, September 14, 2016)
